description.value:
Trigger A starship enters the trap's zone

Effect The trap attempts to pull all creatures on board the triggering starship into the reality breach. Each creature on the starship must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save. The trap then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature claws out from the breach. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is pulled into the breach. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled into the breach. The creature is frightened 2 and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Immobilized], and it can't escape from the breach until the trap is disabled.

details.description: Gnashing, toothy mouths and spiny tentacles grope and writhe inside a pit that just appeared out of nowhere.
details.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:38] (master) or @Check[religion|dc:38] (master) to seal the pit (two successes are required to disable the trap), or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Dispel Magic] (7th rank; counteract DC 37) or planar seal or planar tether (7th rank; counteract DC 33) to counteract the trap
details.routine: (1 action) As an action, the trap manifests mind-rending visions of eldritch creatures from another reality. Each creature inside the reality breach takes @Damage[(3d10+16)[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:35|basic] save). A creature can attempt an Arcana or Occultism check in place of their saving throw, if desired.
